provenance: Yolo County GIS Cooperative public open address points, contributed by county/cities/UC Davis; county describes data as informational, not an authoritative or comprehensive address list.
districtJoin: Point contained by exactly one dissolved district polygon; boundary or ambiguous points excluded.
knownLimitations: Data reflects the published county address-point snapshot; new or unassigned addresses may not be present. Yolo County GIS Cooperative describes this layer as informational and not an authoritative or comprehensive list of county addresses.
